7348.title: Session renewal failures are mistaken for browser failures
7348.rootCauseOneLine: Renewal persistence rejects inside the browser execution error boundary, triggering session cleanup; a second renewal in finally can replace a successful result.
7348.proposedFix: Make renewal persistence best-effort locally while retaining in-memory deadlines and logging failures.
7348.caveats: SDK-host fault injection, not a physical full disk or a real browser run. Repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout. Inactive-record race not reproduced.
